subject: [Invite] Paris AI Leaders Dinner - 21/05
text:
Hi [NAME], 

Our Head of AI is hosting an intimate roundtable dinner for AI & Computer Vision Leaders in Paris and we'd love for you to join us, if you're available.

We've reserved a private dining room for ~20 guests at Maison de l'Amérique Latine on Wednesday 21st May, starting at 6:30 PM. Confirmed attendees include Executives, Heads of AI, Product Leads etc. from H Company, Safran, and Jellysmack. 

In case you're not familiar with Encord, we're a data development platform built to help teams bring better models to market, faster. We work with over 200 AI teams including Woven-Toyota, Synthesia, & Hudl, and have offices in SF & London.

Would you be interested in joining?

subject: Working with Viz.ai to improve AI Algo Performance & Accuracy
text:
Hi [NAME]​,

I saw you were looking to improve AI algorithm accuracy and performance at AIDoc. Reaching out because I've recently been working with Viz.ai for exactly this - to deliver more AI projects to production and more accurate/reliable AI algorithms. 

I lead the Multimodal Medical Imaging AI team at Encord providing efficient annotation tools for precise segmentation DICOM/NIFTII/CT data (e.g. thresholding brush, tracking) built with traceability in mind. Teams tend to come to us as they look to scale & start exploring other modalities (e.g. EHRs). 

Given this seems to be the direction you're also taking, keen to trade notes on what I've been seeing in the Medical Imaging AI space & get your thoughts on what we're building if you're be open to a 30-minute chat this week or the next?
